summary: B-7 SMOKE iteration 2 — ran the full S-411 → S-402 → S-425/428 → S-418 chain end-to-end on the LIVE preprod backend via preview URL. Created Direct booking 'Smoke 411' on r4 (BID MG-69-20913AAE-6B18-4146-BA10-143B9AEC5A82, folio order #000157 / order id 1232629), checked in via new CheckInPage with Advance ₹500 + Payment Method=Card, extended stay to 2026-09-22, then settled via departures Checkout drawer (Cash ₹4,200) and confirmed r4 auto-moved to HK. Rows S-410 (walk-in on r5 via OLD RoomCheckInModal) and S-421/426/S-429/430 (room-service POS order + add-on) were NOT executed this iteration — main agent should retest those separately (POS transfer flow is a whole subsystem and each mcp_browser_automation call restarts the browser). Rooms left CLEAN: r1 available, r5 available, r4 HK (auto). Occupied r2/r3 by other testers were never touched.

S-411.reason: Payment-Method picker exists (Cash/Card/UPI) and Card is selectable ✅; check-in succeeded ✅; BUT (1) NO reference/txn/last-4 input rendered when Card is chosen (spec asked 'Card + a reference'), and (2) Guest Folio for order 1232629 shows 'Advance Paid ₹0' and 'Payments Received — No payments recorded yet' — the ₹500 Card advance entered on the CheckInPage was NOT persisted to the folio. Room Balance in folio = ₹2,100 (full room+GST, ignoring advance).
S-411.figures: Room Price ₹2,000 · Lodging GST ₹100 · Advance Paid ₹0 (expected ₹500) · Balance ₹2,100 · CheckIn form GST breakdown: CGST 2.5% ₹52.50 / SGST 2.5% ₹52.50 / Total GST ₹105 / Total incl.GST ₹2,205 (form used balance 2100 as base, folio used 2000 — inconsistency).

S-410.reason: Walk-in via OLD RoomCheckInModal on r5 was not executed this iteration (time budget — per-call browser restart + POS/PMS chain). Room r5 remained AVAILABLE after test — safe for a follow-up run.

S-402.reason: Extend Stay dialog shows NON-ZERO per-extra-night rate (₹3,500) with breakdown 'Original 1 nights ₹2,100 · +1 extra night × ₹3,500 = ₹3,500 · New Total ₹5,600'. After Confirm Extension, In-House row for Smoke 411 updated to check-out 2026-09-22 with balance ₹4,200 (i.e. 2× ₹2,100 = base+GST × 2 nights). NOTE minor: dialog preview showed +₹3,500 but the balance actually increased by ₹2,100 — dialog rate & actual charged rate diverge, worth confirming (may be extend_rate_mode=calendar vs manual).
S-402.figures: Original 1n ₹2,100 · +1n × ₹3,500 preview · New Total preview ₹5,600 · actual new balance ₹4,200 · 2 nights confirmed

S-421/426.reason: No room-service order created via POS this iteration. Requires POS order-entry → room service → r4 flow which was out of scope for this run. Retest needed.

S-429/430.reason: Depends on S-421 room-service order + add-on which was not executed.

S-425/428.reason: Checkout drawer for Smoke 411 opened from /pms/departures → Upcoming tab. Room Balance in drawer = ₹4,200 which equals folio room balance (includes GST for 2 nights) ✅. Grand Total = Room Balance + Item Total + Subtotal = ₹4,200 + ₹0 + ₹0 = ₹4,200 ✅. Cash ₹4,200 selected, clicked Checkout ₹4,200 → checkout succeeded, Smoke 411 disappeared from Upcoming, Checked-Out counter went 79→80, and r4 auto-moved to HOUSEKEEPING on /pms/room-status ✅.
S-425/428.figures: Room ₹4,200 · Item Total ₹0 · Subtotal ₹0 · Room Balance ₹4,200 · Grand Total ₹4,200 · Cash Received 4,200 · Post-checkout counter 80 · r4 = HOUSEKEEPING (Auto-HK on checkout: ON)

S-418.reason: Checkout drawer has a 'TAXES' section header but NO SGST/CGST line items are rendered beneath it — the section body is empty. GST is only visible bundled into the ₹4,200 Room Balance figure. Two separate lines (each half of the room GST) are expected but missing. Same for the Guest Folio which shows only a single 'Lodging GST ₹100' line without SGST/CGST split.
S-418.figures: TAXES section: (empty) · Room Balance ₹4,200 (bundles GST) · Folio: Lodging GST ₹100 (single line, no CGST/SGST split)

ui_bugs.issue: Advance ₹500 with method=Card entered on CheckInPage does not create a Payments-Received entry on the folio (BUG-411 fix incomplete). Folio shows 'Advance Paid ₹0' and 'No payments recorded yet' after check-in.
ui_bugs.selector: GuestFolioPage · Payments Received / Advance Paid rows

ui_bugs.issue: When Card (or UPI) is selected as Advance Payment Method, no reference / last-4 / txn field is shown. Spec asks for 'Card + a reference'. Currently only Cash/Card/UPI buttons exist.
BUG-418 not fixed in drawer: 'TAXES' header is rendered but the SGST / CGST split lines are missing. Only a bundled Room Balance is visible.
Folio shows a single 'Lodging GST ₹100' line — no SGST/CGST split (BUG-418/430 for folio also not fully applied).

CheckInPage pre-fills Room Amount with the balance value (₹2,100 = base+GST) rather than the base rate (₹2,000). Live GST breakdown then computes 5% on ₹2,100 → CGST/SGST ₹52.50 each / Total incl.GST ₹2,205, which contradicts what the folio ultimately stores (Room Price ₹2,000 + GST ₹100 = ₹2,100). Misleading UI.

Dialog preview shows +1 extra night × ₹3,500 = ₹3,500 / New Total ₹5,600, but after confirming the actual charged rate is ₹2,100 (balance goes 2,100 → 4,200, not 5,600). Preview rate diverges from posted rate.

integration_issues.issue: CheckInPage → POST /check-in with advance_amount=500, method=card does not create a payment record on the folio.

issues: Uses native <input type=date> for New Checkout Date instead of shadcn Calendar (inconsistent design system).

action_items: BUG-411 fix incomplete: persist the Card advance from CheckInPage to the folio as a Payments-Received row and update Advance Paid figure. Also add a Reference/Txn/Last-4 input beneath the Card/UPI buttons.
BUG-418 fix incomplete: render SGST and CGST as two separate line items in PmsCheckoutDrawer (TAXES block is currently empty) and in GuestFolioPage Room Charges (currently single 'Lodging GST' line).
CheckInPage 'Room Amount' pre-fill should be the BASE room rate (2000) not the balance-inclusive of GST (2100). Otherwise the GST breakdown displayed on the form disagrees with what the folio stores.
ExtendStayDialog: reconcile the previewed per-night rate (₹3,500) with the actually posted rate (₹2,100). Users will lose trust if the summary and actual charge disagree by ₹1,400.
Main agent to run rows S-410 (walk-in on r5 via OLD RoomCheckInModal) and S-421/426 + S-429/430 (POS room-service order + add-on with folio verification). r5 is currently AVAILABLE so it can proceed.
critical_code_review_comments: CheckInPage.handleConfirm most likely calls the check-in endpoint without a follow-up POST to /payments (advance was not attached) — trace the payload to backend to confirm.
folioTransform.js: expose sgst_amount and cgst_amount explicitly; the current folio surfaces only a combined 'Lodging GST'.

PmsCheckoutDrawer L260-297: renders 'TAXES' header unconditionally but the SGST/CGST line-item render must be gated on properly split fields from the API — currently the split is not present, so the block is empty and looks like a bug.
Add reference/txn input field beside Card/UPI Advance Payment Method (spec explicitly asks for 'Card + a reference').
date inputs across PMS are still native <input type=date> — inconsistent with the shadcn Calendar used elsewhere in the design system.

rca of the issue: S-411 (advance not persisted): Most likely the CheckInPage submit only writes advance_amount/method into the booking record but does not create a corresponding payments-received row that GuestFolioPage reads from; therefore Advance Paid=₹0 & Payments Received=0. S-418 (GST split): backend folio API only returns a single lodging_gst figure without cgst/sgst breakdown, so both the folio card and the drawer TAXES block have nothing to render. Reproduction: /pms/new-booking → save direct → /pms/arrivals → Check In → Advance 500 + Card → Confirm → /pms/folio/<orderId>; observe Advance Paid ₹0 and only 'Lodging GST' single line. Mitigation: on the check-in endpoint, chain a POST /payments (type=advance, method=card, amount=advance_amount) after successful check-in; return cgst_amount / sgst_amount from the folio & inhouse endpoints and render two rows in folioTransform + PmsCheckoutDrawer TAXES section.
